name: zmodel_const_is_polygon_coplanar
description: zModel_Const::IsPolygonCoplanar verifies every vertex against a computed plane using g_zModel_CoplanarTolerance.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the zModel polygon/source-cluster pass because this helper is coupled to ComputePolygonPlaneEquation x87 code shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482db0 validates the fastcall ABI, stack-local plane, call to zModel_Const::ComputePolygonPlaneEquation, empty-polygon success, per-vertex plane-distance test, and g_zModel_CoplanarTolerance comparison.
The native smoke verifies coplanar success for a square, non-coplanar rejection after moving one vertex out of plane, and empty-polygon success.
